verdict.rationale: Datadog is a SaaS platform with AI features such as Bits AI and an MCP server, so a buyer could fairly ask whether it offers an AI-training opt-out; the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a training opt-out, a no-training commitment, or a data-usage control for AI models. Sensitive Data Scanner is a different feature (redaction) and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
